color.name: --card-fill
color.raw:
linear-gradient(
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 42%, transparent),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 58%, transparent)
  )

other.name: --gradient-surface
other.raw:
linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--nx-surface) 70%, var(--nx-bg-2)) 0%,
    var(--nx-bg-1) 100%
  )

other.name: --gradient-glass
other.raw:
linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--nx-cyan) 6%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--nx-cyan-3) 3%, transparent) 100%
  )
